follow_ups.title: 083d MSN-E2E-001 shipping step contradicts its own fixture
follow_ups.detail: The step says 'select an available Fixed Rate delivery method', but the only Fixed Rate options on vcst-qa are Ground $150 / Air $250, while co-granting mission MSN_E2E_ORDERVALUE_008 records order_shipping_max: 10 and the seeder measured measured_shipping: 0 / measured_total: 18 — i.e. it measured over BOPIS Pickup. Consequence: the seeder's recorded co-grant deltas are not reproducible via the step as written (order 1 delta 3887 actual vs order1_expected_delta 1058; order 2 1316 vs reward_expected_total 1307). Verdicts still stand because an OrderCountGoal is shipping-blind. Two further staleness items in the same case: [PRE:SIGNIN_AS:LOYALTY_VIP_USER] is stale (ran on MSN_E2E_USER_001), and the step hardcodes 'quantity 1' against the fixture's order_units: 3.

follow_ups.title: OrderValueGoal reading includes tax and shipping — corroborates BL-LOY-016
follow_ups.detail: On an order with only $15 merchandise but a $198 total, the missions targeting $36, $49.50, $50 and $54 ALL completed, so the effective reading is orderTotal rather than net/gross merchandise. This is not a new invariant — it independently confirms BL-LOY-016 ('A mission goal measures the ORDER TOTAL — shipping and tax included, net of discount', P0-revenue) from a second, unrelated run. It also bears directly on MSN-E2E-003 and MSN-E2E-005, whose separation margins assume a merchandise-scoped reading, and it is the mechanism behind the delta blow-up in FU-8.

follow_ups.title: MSN-021's expected-count is the wrong SHAPE of assertion, not just a stale number
follow_ups.detail: Amount-based identification degrades as runs accumulate: the freshly seeded ORDERCOUNT mission again carries reward 501, and prior AGENT-TEST- missions are not torn down until a sweep, so several Published missions share any given reward amount. Wave 2 then showed three rows sharing the identical amount 500. Re-pointing MSN-021 to a new literal count will drift again; it needs an assertion that does not identify a grant by its amount.

follow_ups.title: A zero-target OrderCount mission never completes
follow_ups.detail: AGENT-TEST-MSN-ZEROTARGET (reward 200) reads currentValue 1 / targetValue 0 / percentage 0 and never completes — the exact 200-point shortfall that broke MSN-033's absolute balance oracle (settled 1894 vs expected 2074). Needs a product decision: is a 0 target degenerate by design, or is this a completion-check defect? Not filed.

follow_ups.title: Missing pickupLocationId surfaces as a raw DB_UPDATE/SQL error and poisons the cart
follow_ups.detail: addOrUpdateCartShipment with BuyOnlinePickupInStore and no pickupLocationId returns HTTP 200 with data:null and extensions.code DB_UPDATE (codes DB_UPDATE, SQL) rather than a validation error. The cart is then poisoned: the next addOrUpdateCartPayment fails identically, and createOrderFromCart afterwards returns ZERO errors while producing an order with shipments:[] and inPayments:[]. Isolated across four controlled trials on one account/cart/address. Not filed.

follow_ups.title: reward_expected_total omits the base accrual and drifts every seed
follow_ups.detail: It excludes the +20 base CustomerOrder accrual the same order always writes, so no absolute equality against it can hold even on a fresh account. It also re-measures upward as prior AGENT-TEST- generations survive: 1058 -> 1566 -> 2074 inside one day. Either include the base accrual and document the metric, or stop publishing it as an equality oracle.

follow_ups.title: Stale AUTH-BLOCKS note in 4 further 075d rows
follow_ups.detail: The 'AUTH role BLOCKS at token acquisition' boilerplate appears in 5 rows. MSN-027 and MSN-033 were corrected under this repair; 4 remain, outside the scope set for this pass.

follow_ups.title: Seeder teardown cannot clear same-day generations
follow_ups.detail: seed:missions-e2e:teardown spares anything younger than 6h, so re-seeding inside that window adds a generation instead of replacing one. Two re-seeds today left three missions at reward 501 and three at 508, which is what made every amount-based per-mission assertion ambiguous. Clear the AGENT-TEST-MSN-E2E-* set once the window opens, before the next 075d or 083d run.

test_repairs.runner_grammar_finding: [DATA] >= with an ARITHMETIC right-hand side is unsupported. classifyDataPredicate tries >= first as cross-path (both sides must be data. paths), then as PATH >= <single number>; an expression such as {{VAR}} + @td(...) matches neither and falls through to the =-split branch, which splits inside the >= itself and yields a junk operand -> T-005 prose-operand. Express such a bound as a single @td() value, or as cross-path. The same limitation applies inside a [WAIT] predicate, where it degrades silently into a fixed sleep rather than failing.
test_repairs.process_note: Three near-misses were caught by the edit guard rather than by review: a file-wide SHIP_CODE replace that would have corrupted three unrelated cases; two comma insertions into UNQUOTED CSV fields that split rows to 18 and 27 columns; and one stripped CR leaving a bare LF. Row-scoped edits with an occurrence-count assertion, plus a re-gate after every write, are what made these recoverable.
